scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,extension -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w @opentrackmail/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @opentrackmail/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @opentrackmail/shared && npm run build -w @opentrackmail/dashboard && npm run build -w @opentrackmail/extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @opentrackmail/dashboard && npm run test -w @opentrackmail/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @opentrackmail/shared && npm run typecheck -w @opentrackmail/dashboard && npm run typecheck -w @opentrackmail/extension
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @opentrackmail/dashboard && npm run lint -w @opentrackmail/extension
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
